description: Does this car have lane departure warning or forward collision warning as standard? Returns whether electronic stability control, forward collision warning and lane departure warning are standard, optional or not available, per body style, for a make, model and model year. For buyers comparing trims and insurers. Source: NHTSA NCAP records. It covers only these three technologies and only cars in the NCAP programme; it does not cover automatic emergency braking or other features. (cost: 1 credit)

make.description: string, required, vehicle make, e.g. honda

model.description: string, required, US model name, e.g. accord

name: vehicle_driver_assist_features
